name: Umbilical (CR +1)
body:
Egregores are typically ephemeral entities nurtured within a single locale by a small body of creatures, but some magical scholars have discovered methods of improving the longevity of these psychic collectives. Tethering an egregore’s existence to an omphalos or living idol creates what is known as an umbilical egregore, a being that sustains itself through a current of soul-infused power and bestows unique blessings upon its followers.

Umbilical is a template which can be applied to any egregore (referred to hereafter as the base creature). An umbilical egregore uses all the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature +1.

Special Attacks: An umbilical egregore gains the reforge connection:

Reforge Connections (Su)

As a standard action, if the umbilical egregore currently has fewer members of its cult mind than it has Hit Dice, it may add a creature within 30 feet to its cult mind. Such a creature must be a dedicate of the umbilical egregore’s omphalos or a worshipper of its living idol. If the umbilical egregore is ethereal, it may use this ability on creatures on the Material Plane.

Spell-like Abilities: An umbilical egregore gains the following spell-like abilities.

At will—ethereal jaunt, locate creature (dedicates of the umbilical egregore’s omphalos or worshippers of its living idol only)

Special Qualities: An umbilical egregore gains the following special qualities:

Connected Perseverance (Ex)

An umbilical egregore does not have a cult leader. Members of an umbilical egregore’s cult mind do not need to attempt Will saves to resist being sickened when a member of the cult mind is slain, and an umbilical egregore does not risk becoming confused when reduced below a certain number of cult mind members.

Rather than disappearing when there are no cult mind members left, the egregore instead becomes ethereal (as per the ethereal jaunt spell) until it can add new creatures to its cult mind via the reforge connection ability. If the omphalos or living idol tied to the umbilical egregore is destroyed, the umbilical egregore dissipates harmlessly immediately.

Vessel of Devotion (Su)

All creatures that are members of the umbilical egregore’s cult mind gain a +1 sacred bonus to AC, on attack rolls, and saving throws. When a member of the umbilical egregore’s cult mind dies, the creature’s soul merges with the umbilical egregore for up to one day per Hit

Die the umbilical egregore possesses. During this time, it can be affected by raise dead and similar abilities as if it died within 1 round, without need for the creature’s corpse. If the umbilical egregore dies, the creature’s soul departs, killing it.

Creating an Umbilical Egregore

The same ritual used to create an egregore can also be used to create an umbilical egregore provided that all members of the initial cult mind are dedicates of the same omphalos or worshippers of the same living idol . The cost of the ritual improves to 1,100 gp per Hit Dice of the umbilical egregore from 1,000.
